name: dev-flow-codex
description: Worktree-first Dev Flow lifecycle integration for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Assess and isolate Dev Flow tasks
interface.longDescription: Assess development requests before the user chooses direct work or Dev Flow, then provision every new Dev Flow Task from a confirmed remote and base in a dedicated named-branch worktree. The $dev-flow-codex:dev-flow selector does not skip assessment; explicit resume returns to the original worktree.
defaultPrompt: $dev-flow-codex:dev-flow assess the requested change in this repository before starting Dev Flow.
